title: PHQ-9 Patient Health Questionnaire
description: Validated 9-item depression screening tool. Scored 0-27; higher scores indicate greater depression severity.

sections.title: Over the last two weeks
sections.instructions: Over the last two weeks, how often have you been bothered by any of the following problems?

questions.text: Little interest or pleasure in doing things?
questions.conversational_hint: How much have you been able to enjoy the things you usually like to do?
How often have you been feeling down or like things won't get better?

questions.text: Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much?
questions.conversational_hint: How has your sleep been lately — any trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or finding yourself sleeping a lot more than usual?

questions.text: Feeling tired or having little energy?
questions.conversational_hint: How would you describe your energy levels — have you been feeling unusually tired or worn out?
Has your appetite changed at all — eating much less than usual, or finding yourself eating a lot more?

questions.text: Feeling bad about yourself — or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down?
questions.conversational_hint: Have you been having thoughts like feeling you've let people down, or feeling badly about yourself?

questions.text: Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television?
questions.conversational_hint: How has your concentration been — trouble focusing on reading, watching TV, or staying on task?

questions.text: Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed? Or the opposite — being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual?
questions.conversational_hint: Have others noticed you moving or talking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, feeling very restless and unable to stay still?

questions.text: Thoughts that you would be better off dead, or of hurting yourself in some way?
questions.conversational_hint: This next question is important for your safety — have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself or that you would be better off not being here?

sections.title: Functional impact
sections.instructions: If you checked off any problems, how difficult have these problems made it for you to do your work, take care of things at home, or get along with other people?

questions.text: How difficult have these problems made it to do your work, take care of things at home, or get along with other people?
questions.conversational_hint: Overall, how much have these feelings affected your day-to-day life — things like work, home responsibilities, or getting along with others?
